# World Brief — Sunday, 01 November 2026

**In one line:** India's GST collections surged 23% to ₹2.31 lakh crore amid festive buying, while Binance resumed withdrawals after the FBI tied its $6.3B breach to North Korea, and Cyclone Murasu formed over the Bay of Bengal.

## 🚨 Top 5 things to know
- ✅ CONFIRMED **UPDATE** — **Binance resumes withdrawals as FBI links $6.3B heist to North Korea**
  *What happened:* Binance announced it is **resuming withdrawals on Sunday** after covering **95% of customer losses** from its $6.3 billion hack [[Dawn]](https://www.dawn.com/news/2041364/binance-to-resume-withdrawals-after-covering-bulk-of-stolen-63bn) [[Al Jazeera]](https://news.google.?oc=5). The FBI officially attributed the exploit to the North Korean state-backed cyber group TraderTraitor [[DW]](https://www.dw.com/en/fbi-says-north-korea-behind-6-billion-binance-crypto-theft/a-79819998?maca=en-rss-en-world-4025-rdf).
  *Why it matters:* This eases immediate panic across crypto markets, though questions linger over how exchanges will protect against state-sponsored exploits [[Dawn]](https://www.dawn.com/news/2041364/binance-to-resume-withdrawals-after-covering-bulk-of-stolen-63bn) [[BigGo Finance]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1QT2p2ZnY4T0h6b0V6Qk8zYUFUVW9FZjBCSmloWkRCR2dBaU1TZXAtd2F2Yzl6MVFSRW5fN190MHhMSlhPaGFOTWNIcGVnbWFMTTNHVDhaSnktX3dXUTdBd1RmSDV5b2hOd2psVXROS25lazFpd3c?oc=5).

- 🟡 DEVELOPING **NEW** — **Bay of Bengal spawns Cyclone Murasu, triggering red alerts in Andhra Pradesh**
  *What happened:* A deep depression intensified into **severe Cyclone Murasu**, heading toward the Andhra coast with winds up to **120 km/h** ahead of an expected landfall around November 3 [[The New Indian Express]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Firstpost]](https://news.google.?oc=5). Andhra Pradesh issued red alerts across 5 districts, while Telangana sounded an orange alert for 6 districts [[Livemint]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Why it matters:* Coastal districts face heavy storm surges and crop risks right after recovering from Cyclone Arnab, prompting early evacuations and emergency deployments [[India Today]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Hindustan Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

- ✅ CONFIRMED **NEW** — **India’s October GST collections jump 23% to record ₹2.31 lakh crore**
  *What happened:* Gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenue jumped **23% year-on-year to ₹2.31 lakh crore** in October, marking the fastest revenue growth in over four years [[Moneycontrol.com]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[NDTV]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Why it matters:* Robust festive spending and auto deliveries drove the spike, strengthening government finances ahead of late-year infrastructure spending [[RushLane]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[NDTV]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

- 🟡 DEVELOPING **UPDATE** — **Youth cost-of-living unrest spreads from France into Germany**
  *What happened:* Hundreds of thousands marched across France for a third weekend, leading to **over 770 arrests** [[Al Jazeera]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[The Times of Israel]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOZU9KOFk1SmJ2d0x5VEVjUS1Tbm0ta05ITDhIQlVkY2ptZm52dDdhV2lDTXdrOVlXbkFNMDdjZWFyNEdtVW5hQW9uRlh2X0ZRbGVaZWdCdW9lN1Z4QmFmRWMwMldKaV9HRXh0eDRMbDJwNDdWRUR5cGh2ajBjSGt4TUdISWJWRGN6RHJPX3VibVFveVQzTHdUS2JGaElfcFRNNnVBeXpxeHdjeFE?oc=5). ## ✅ What actually matters today

- **Binance restores access after North Korean state hack**
  *What happened:* Binance resumed customer withdrawals after backstopping **95% of the $6.3 billion** stolen in the largest crypto heist in history [[Dawn]](https://www.dawn.com/news/2041364/binance-to-resume-withdrawals-after-covering-bulk-of-stolen-63bn). The US FBI formally identified North Korea’s "TraderTraitor" hacking ring as the culprit [[DW]](https://www.dw.com/en/fbi-says-north-korea-behind-6-billion-binance-crypto-theft/a-79819998?maca=en-rss-en-world-4025-rdf).
  *Why it happened:* Attackers compromised exchange infrastructure, but Binance covered customer balances using internal emergency reserves [[Dawn]](https://www.dawn.com/news/2041364/binance-to-resume-withdrawals-after-covering-bulk-of-stolen-63bn) [[World News]](https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/binance-hack-north-korea-9.7404502?cmp=rss).
  *Why it matters:* It prevents a catastrophic solvency run on digital assets, but demonstrates the vulnerability of centralized crypto repositories to sovereign cyber warfare [[BigGo Finance]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1QT2p2ZnY4T0h6b0V6Qk8zYUFUVW9FZjBCSmloWkRCR2dBaU1TZXAtd2F2Yzl6MVFSRW5fN190MHhMSlhPaGFOTWNIcGVnbWFMTTNHVDhaSnktX3dXUTdBd1RmSDV5b2hOd2psVXROS25lazFpd3c?oc=5) [[DW]](https://www.dw.com/en/fbi-says-north-korea-behind-6-billion-binance-crypto-theft/a-79819998?maca=en-rss-en-world-4025-rdf).
  *Who is affected:* Global cryptocurrency holders, institutional trading desks, and exchange operators [[Dawn]](https://www.dawn.com/news/2041364/binance-to-resume-withdrawals-after-covering-bulk-of-stolen-63bn) [[BigGo Finance]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1QT2p2ZnY4T0h6b0V6Qk8zYUFUVW9FZjBCSmloWkRCR2dBaU1TZXAtd2F2Yzl6MVFSRW5fN190MHhMSlhPaGFOTWNIcGVnbWFMTTNHVDhaSnktX3dXUTdBd1RmSDV5b2hOd2psVXROS25lazFpd3c?oc=5).

- **Cyclone Murasu threatens southeastern Indian coast**
  *What happened:* Cyclone Murasu gathered strength over the Bay of Bengal, forecast to strike coastal Andhra Pradesh near November 3 with **sustained gusts up to 120 km/h** [[The New Indian Express]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Firstpost]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Why it happened:* Warm post-monsoon sea temperatures in the Bay of Bengal spawned rapid intensification following last week's storm [[Business Standard]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[ETV Bharat]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Why it matters:* Coastal transport, rail lines, and standing paddy crops in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, and eastern Telangana face immediate flash-flooding disruptions [[Livemint]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[India Today]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Who is affected:* Coastal residents, farmers, and transport operators across Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, and Telangana [[Livemint]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Hindustan Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *What happens next:* National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) teams are deploying, while local administrations initiate coastal evacuations [[India Today]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Hindustan Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

- **October GST revenue hits four-year growth record**
  *What happened:* India collected **₹2.31 lakh crore in gross GST** in October, climbing 23% over the prior year [[Moneycontrol.com]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[NDTV]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Why it happened:* Peak Diwali purchasing, record car deliveries by automakers like Maruti Suzuki, and stronger electronic compliance drove collections [[RushLane]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[NDTV]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Why it matters:* The tax cushion gives the central government fiscal room to manage subsidies and infrastructure spending despite high imported crude bills [[Moneycontrol.com]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
  *Who is affected:* Indian businesses, state treasuries receiving tax devolution, and fiscal budget planners [[Moneycontrol.com]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[RBI (official)]](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63896).
  *What happens next:* Focus turns to whether consumer demand holds steady in post-festive November volumes [[Livemint]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5) [[Moneycontrol.com]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 🎓 Today's lesson: What is a Greener/Fresh Issue vs. Offer for Sale (OFS)?
When a company launches an Initial Public Offering (IPO), it sells shares through two very different buckets:
1. **Fresh Issue:** The company creates and sells brand-new shares. All the proceeds flow straight into the company's bank account to build factories, hire engineers, pay down loans, or fund research.
2. **Offer for Sale (OFS):** No new shares are created. Instead, early founders, venture capitalists, or promoters sell a portion of their existing shares to the public. The proceeds go directly into the sellers' pockets, and the company receives zero rupees or dollars from that portion.

*Everyday example:* Think of a neighborhood bakery. If the owner sells new partner shares to buy a larger commercial oven, that is a fresh issue (the business grows). If the owner sells half their personal ownership to buy a sports car, that is an OFS. Checking the ratio between Fresh Issue and OFS in an offer document tells you whether your investment funds company growth or cashes out earlier backers.
